description: Routing coverage: which fallback chain each intent should select.

evals.prompt: Search the web for a 2026 comparison of AI search engines and give me a high-quality synthesized answer.
evals.expected_output: Activate web-search with the deep chain: Perplexity -> Bing -> Google -> Brave, reading results via the getText action, with automatic fallback on block.

evals.prompt: Find the official website and GitHub repository for the OpenClaw project.
evals.expected_output: Activate web-search with the web chain: Google -> Bing -> Brave -> DuckDuckGo.

evals.prompt: Search privately for open-source AI agent tools.
evals.expected_output: Activate web-search with the privacy chain: Brave -> DuckDuckGo -> Bing.

evals.prompt: Look this up online: what changed in the latest iOS release?
evals.expected_output: Activate web-search, spawn a sub-agent to drive WebBrowserTool, read results with getText, and fall back across engines if one is blocked.
